traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of selfhood and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: A beautiful possibility can feel more inevitable when it reflects an identity, ideal, or future people deeply want to believe in.

readerCopy.body: A beautiful possibility can feel more inevitable when it reflects an identity, ideal, or future people deeply want to believe in. When the Sun conjoins Neptune, purpose and imagination fuse, strengthening inspiration, intuition, creativity, and projection at the same time. The dream may deserve attention while ordinary warning signs still deserve scrutiny. What matters can survive a closer look without requiring the fantasy to prove who anyone is meant to become.
